articles.summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has fundamentally changed enterprise technology conversation. Just a few years ago, organizations were asking whether AI was ready for business. Today, that question has been replaced by a far more complex one: How do we make AI work for our business?
articles.title: Your Move: Choosing the AI Journey That’s Right for Your Business

articles.summary: Across India's Global Capability Centers (GCCs), artificial intelligence (AI) has moved well beyond experimentation. Dedicated AI Centers of Excellence (CoE) are becoming increasingly common; enterprise pilots are delivering measurable results, and leadership teams are now under increasing pressure to translate early success into enterprise-wide value.
articles.title: Scaling GenAI in Global Capability Centers Beyond the AI CoE

articles.summary: In the first episode of Season 2, we explore one of the biggest questions facing enterprises today: How can organizations scale AI securely, efficiently, and at scale? Trisha sits down with Pushpendra Kumar, Product Head – Cloud, AI & IT Managed Services at Sify, to discuss why successful AI adoption requires much more than powerful models. From cloud and data centers to security, sovereignty, managed services, and cost optimization, this episode unpacks the complete AI ecosystem enterprises need to build for long-term success.
articles.title: Episode 2: Building AI-Ready Enterprises: Infrastructure, Leadership & ROI in the AI Era
